Tests, exercises and  practical works..
versoes.criterio:
Média  = (2P + L)/3

Trabalhos Práticos

Criterion for approval:

Final grade  = (2P + L)/3
P = average of the grades of tests

1 written test accomplished in the week reserved for remedial work.

Goals:

At the end of the course  the students : should  know environmental aspects and this relation with safety in industrial chemical process and  develop the skills for identification of risks and  to analyze  the consequences of these.
